about: Pass 6 research (2026-10-09), topic Terminal-Bench Hard: find other models measured on Command A+'s 'Terminal-Bench Hard 25%' (Cohere blog; stored under terminalbench-hard-gemma4) so the result can be read against them, plus any allowed independent source that measured Command A+ on other tests. Candidate rows only; data/ was not edited. Merge order: ledger entries first (strip action/evidence_url/scope/note; add_match entries extend existing entries), then models, then results via npm run import. No new benchmark id is proposed: every TB-Hard row maps to terminalbench-hard-gemma4 (identity verdict in held_for_owner[0]); the Solar Open 2 rows for other tests map to existing ids. 64 rows: 16 TB-Hard rows in 6 new or extended runs (13 independent, 3 lab) plus 48 independent Solar Open 2 rows for Command A+ and three peers on 12 other existing ids; 1 comparison-only model (qwen3-vl-32b-thinking); 3 new run ledgers (Solar Open 2, HyperCLOVA X, Multiverse), 1 new pooled NVIDIA ModelOpt card ledger, 2 add_match. Scratch merge on the 2026-10-09 tree: check.ts --validate-only passes (1,312 models, 14,048 results); every row resolves to its intended ledger id; Command A+ moves 66.8 (rank 91/700, 7 cells) to 65.4 (rank 113) with the TB-Hard rows alone and to 61.6 (rank 178/701, 20 cells) with everything. Details in pass6-tbhard-2026-10-09.md.

held_for_owner.identity_verdict: Same test, keep one id. 'Terminal-Bench Hard' is the hard-task subset of the original (pre-2.0) Terminal-Bench, terminal-bench-core at commit 74221fb, run with the Terminus 2 agent, as used in the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: 47 tasks (Falcon-H1R report; HyperCLOVA X report 'the 47 challenging tasks from the artificial analysis split'; NVIDIA NeMo Evaluator terminal_bench_hard.py lists the 47 task names and a 44-task 'AA split'); NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Super report says '48 tasks'. Cohere's figure is its own run with 'Terminus-2 harness following the methodology of Artificial Analysis'. The Gemma 4 report prints only the row name 'Terminal Bench Hard' (thinking mode) with no task count, harness or footnote; its only Terminal-Bench citation is the Terminal-Bench 2.0 paper (Merrill et al. 2026, a bulk citation), which Solar Open 2 also cites for the same row name. Nothing indicates Gemma's row is a different test (the reports that run TB 2.0 label it 'Terminal Bench 2.0' separately), so Cohere's and Gemma's rows are not 'clearly different' and no separate id is proposed. It is not a version of terminal-bench-2 / 2.1 / 3 / 4 / pre-2 / 1-terminus1 and must stay separate from them. Variants seen: 47 vs 44 (AA split) vs 48 tasks, 1-8 repeats; recorded per row in note.
